title: Knowledge Base document DTO (P3, GET /kb/documents, GET /kb/documents/:id)
description: One Knowledge Base document: Markdown with [[path]] wikilinks, owned by the organization library (scope organization) or by one Work of the organization (scope work), filed in a library folder or Unfiled. Also the data of kb.document.* events. Not a ResourceBase: it has no owner, visibility or teams of its own; it is readable by everyone who can read its organization or its Work. `revision` moves only on a real change to the title, description, tags, class or body and `normalizedContentHash` fingerprints the body; `version` moves on every recorded change and is the ETag. An event whose body is longer than 262144 UTF-8 bytes carries `body: null, bodyOmitted: true`; GET always carries the body (CR-7).

organizationId.description: The organization the document belongs to (a Work document: its Work's organization).

folderId.description: The organization library folder it is filed in; null = Unfiled.

path.description: Relative to the knowledge base root, e.g. brand/voice.md.

class.description: Document class. Every class may live at organization scope; only legal, style and seo are inherited into Works.

reviewState.description: proposed = agent-written and waiting for a person (POST /kb/documents/:id/accept); null on rows that predate review.

source.description: Open set; consumers must accept unknown values.

body.description: The Markdown body; null only with bodyOmitted in an event.

bodyOmitted.description: Only in an event whose body exceeds the event body limit: GET /kb/documents/:id for the body.

decision.description: The decision lifecycle of a decision-class document (read-only), else null.

id.description: The organization id, or the Work id.
